ترتبطن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَبِطْنَ (tartabiṭna) /tar.ta.bitˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# تُرْتَبَطْنَ (turtabaṭna) /tur.ta.batˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
